source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary: After the Canis Rex model has been destroyed, Sir Hekhtur must make an Emergency Disembarkation as if leaving a destroyed **TRANSPORT**. Of your Stratagems, only Core Stratagems can target Sir Hekhtur. The Canis Rex unit counts as destroyed only once Sir Hekhtur is destroyed as well.

ability.trigger: your Canis Rex model is destroyed
ability.effect: Sir Hekhtur treated as disembarking from a destroyed TRANSPORT and must make an Emergency Disembarkation
